text:
dan: Heads-up: multiple tenants reported sudden unit increases after yesterday's runtime roll (kernel v2). Seems estimator now uses batch-max-dims for estimates even when header is missing.

maria: Oof. can you share a repro and logs?

dan: sample sanitized request below (no X-Embed-Dims):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-v2","input":["short a","short b","short c"]}'
```

dan: preflight/logs: 
```
preflight: items=3, sample_lens=[8,9,7]
preflight: inferred_dims_per_item=[1536,1536,1536]
estimator: previous=per-item-sum -> estimated_units=3*48=144
estimator: current=batch-max -> estimated_units=1*2048=2048
routing: chosen=fastpath
quota: billed_units=144 (actual) but customer saw initial console estimate spike to 2048
```

sam: That explains the console hairball. We changed estimator logic last week to "prefer max" to avoid underestimating mixed batches with large blobs, but it shouldn't apply when all items are small. Bug likely in the thresholding logic.

kevin: Console impact: time-series points showed huge transient estimate; customers auto-throttled and support tickets spiked. We need both a quick mitigation and a longer-term policy.

dan: quick mitigation idea: server rollback estimator to "legacy-per-item" for the next 24h flag `embed.estimate_strategy=legacy` while we fix logic.

maria: Yes + surface in Console per-request `estimate_strategy` and a small banner if estimate > billed * 4. That reduces panic.

sam: Agreed. Root cause I think: a recent refactor made the "small batch" predicate check (all_items_len < 2KB) invert. I'll prep hotfix. Meanwhile a graceful mitigation: when estimator returns > billed_threshold, emit ephemeral estimate and mark `estimate_tentative=true` in audit logs and UI.

ops-bot: Created INF-2955 "estimator: batch-max applied to small homogeneous batches after kernel v2" assigned to @sam and @dan.

billing-bot: Note: Billing system only charges on final computed units, but the console shows the optimistic estimate. We have auto-credit policy but it doesn't cover contaminated estimates. BILL-770 created.

kevin: UI asks: can we add a temporary legend in Cost dashboard "Estimate mode: batch-max (rolling)" and a link to live incidents? Also add a filter to hide tentative estimates.

maria: telemetry additions requested: metric `embed.estimate_strategy` keyed by route, `estimate_tentative_count`, `estimate_vs_final_ratio` histogram. We also need per-tenant tag to identify heavy false positives.

sam: rollout plan: 1) push hotfix to restore legacy-per-item default; 2) enable tentative-estimate badge and telemetry; 3) run canary for 1h, then full rollback if no regressions. After rollback, schedule proper fix: keep batch-max but only if any sampled_item_len > 2k OR header indicates big dims.

dan: also: client SDKs should add a debug helper `compute_embed_dims()` to reduce ambiguity; we'll publish patch and sample usage.

kevin: Support message drafted to tenants explaining console transient estimates and that actual billing unaffected. I'll hold until hotfix lands.

ops-bot: TASK-428 created: "console: show estimate_tentative badge + hide filter" assigned to @kevin.

sam: I'll post PR/CI link and request an expedited rollback. If anyone sees other surprises in telemetry, ping me.

maria: thanks. after rollback we should add a dashboard card showing top N tenants who saw estimate spikes in last 24h so support can proactively reach out.

dan: agreed. closing loop after hotfix. Thanks team :thumbsup:
